podcast.title: Debut Solo Work After Years of Collaboration
podcast.body: Mark Peters, an electronic producer and musician, has a long history of collaborative work but released his first solo album, "Innerland," only in 2017. This marked a significant departure from his previous focus on working with other artists. "lleva muchos años trabajando pero trabajando con gente nunca ha sacado un disco al sol."

podcast.title: Rapid Cassette Sell-Out
podcast.body: The initial cassette release of "Innerland" in 2017 sold out completely within five minutes, demonstrating the high demand for his work among intellectual electronic music enthusiasts. "se agotó como en cinco minutos todos los intelectores de electrónica fueron a compártelo."

podcast.title: Respected UK Producer
podcast.body: Mark Peters is a highly respected figure within the electronic music scene in the United Kingdom, recognized for his extensive work and contributions. "es un tío muy respetado ha hecho por primera vez su trabajo en solitario."
